title: 百人袭击医院：只为抢回埃博拉死者，安全葬礼如何推行？
speaker: Declan Walsh

segments.en: It's an absolutely crucial point when you speak to aid workers the second the first thing they'll tell you is they need equipment.
segments.zh: 这是一个关键点：当你与援助人员交谈时，他们首先会告诉你他们需要设备。

segments.en: The second thing they'll say they need is education and engagement with these communities some of these communities are extremely hostile to the virus.
segments.zh: 其次他们需要的是教育和社区参与，一些社区对病毒极为敌视。

segments.en: It's not just or it's out to the idea of the virus.
segments.zh: 不仅仅是针对病毒本身。

segments.en: It's not just that they don't believe it exists they have carried out attacks against hospitals the hospital that I visited had an isolation ward that was under construction burned down.
segments.zh: 他们不仅不相信病毒存在，还袭击医院。我访问的那家医院，一个在建的隔离病房被烧毁。

segments.en: It came under attack the first night we were there from a group of over a hundred people who wanted to retrieve the body of a local spiritual leader who had just died of Ebola.
segments.zh: 我们到达的第一晚，医院就遭到一百多人的袭击，他们想取回一位刚死于埃博拉的当地精神领袖的尸体。

segments.en: And what that all gets to is the whole practice of funerals.
segments.zh: 这一切都指向葬礼习俗。

segments.en: I think as you noted you know the body of a person a person is most contagious at the last stages of the disease and after they have died.
segments.zh: 正如你所说，人在疾病末期和死后传染性最强。

segments.en: So how the dead are buried is absolutely crucial otherwise funerals can turn into super spreader events.
segments.zh: 因此如何安葬死者至关重要，否则葬礼可能成为超级传播事件。

segments.en: So you see these really courageous local health workers and red cross officials who are doing their best to educate people to try and carry out safe burials of bodies.
segments.zh: 所以你会看到这些勇敢的当地卫生工作者和红十字会官员，他们尽力教育人们，尝试进行安全埋葬。

segments.en: But because frankly the effort is so far behind the curve as I said this outbreak is thought to have started probably six weeks maybe two months ago but was only declared discovered and declared two weeks ago.
segments.zh: 但坦白说，努力远远落后于疫情发展。这次疫情可能早在六周甚至两个月前就已开始，但直到两周前才被发现和宣布。

segments.en: So the entire effort is far behind the curve which means there's very little reliable data about how much it has spread.
segments.zh: 所以整个应对工作严重滞后，这意味着关于疫情传播程度的数据非常不可靠。

segments.en: And that's only feeding into this suspicion among local communities who as far as they're concerned see people going into hospitals just to die.
segments.zh: 这只会加剧当地社区的怀疑，在他们看来，人们进医院只是为了等死。
